entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: Assertion failed 'm_blockLayout->CanAssignFrom(m_src->GetLayout(m_comp))' during 'Morph - Global' #115979
    10.0.0

Closed

  • Wrong culture returned from CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("") #115913
    10.0.0
  • JIT: Assertion failed 'dsc->TypeGet() != TYP_BYREF' during 'Transform async' #115894
    10.0.0
  • Suggestion: Rename `System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName` to `System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryPath` for clarity #115965

PullRequests

Created

  • Switch to ymm after zmm in genZeroInitFrameUsingBlockInit #115981
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Remove bounds check for arr1[arr2.Length] pattern #115980
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • PipeWriter.UnflushedBytes long property wraps to negative numbers after int.MaxValue #115978
    area-System.IO.Pipelines, community-contribution
  • JIT: Support bitwise field insertions for call arguments #115977
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: Allow forward subbing no-return calls #115976
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: Add a `gtFindNodeInTree` helper #115975
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Unbounded memory leak from DependencyInjectionEventSource #115974
    area-Extensions-DependencyInjection, community-contribution

Merged

  • Fix Creating Undermined Culture #115919
    area-System.Globalization, 10.0.0
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 136.0.7103.113, windows: 137.0.7151.41 #115969
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono
  • Disable Android tests in default CI set for now #115973
    needs-area-label
  • JIT: Disallow forward substitution of async calls #115936
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Updated

  • Fix parsing of json with UTF 8 BOM in the host #115967
    area-Host, 10.0.0
  • Use UnsafeAccessorType in System.Private.CoreLib and the BCL #115583
    needs-area-label
  • Fixup how xarch instructions check for embedded broadcast and masking support #115704
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix intermittent failures in PAL tests #115958
    area-PAL-coreclr
  • Support out of proc Histogram Base 2 Exponential aggregation #115852
    area-System.Diagnostics.Metric, 10.0.0
  • Fix PipeStream leak on Windows when pipe is disposed with a pending operation #115453
    area-System.IO
  • Enable new exception handling on win-x86 #115957
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [TEST] Enable runtime async tests #115947
    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW, area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2716802 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • Added exfat enum entry #115963
    area-System.IO, community-contribution, needs-author-action
  • [RuntimeAsync] ilasm/ildasm support for the MethodImpl.Async (Take 2) #115658
    area-ILTools-coreclr, community-contribution, runtime-async
  • JIT: Allow any baseline intrinsics in lowering #115592
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Sve: Preliminary support for agnostic VL for JIT scenarios #115948
    NO-REVIEW, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Record exception in HttpClient native instrumentation #115959
    area-System.Net.Http, community-contribution
  • Improve Math.BigMul on x64 by adding new internal `Multiply` hardware intrinsic to X86Base #115966
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • [release/9.0-staging] fix: in rsa signatures, configure digest before padding mode #115695
    Servicing-approved, area-System.Security, 9.0.7
  • Option to disallow duplicate JSON properties #115856
    area-System.Text.Json
  • [release/10.0-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #115937
    area-codeflow
